tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: put a loop on tape
steps: On a track playing a drum or bass loop, hold FUNC and press FX2, turn LEVEL to IRONOXIDE5 and press YES. Press FX2 to see INPUT, HIGH, LOW, OUT and MIX at their defaults.
Turn INPUT up to about 90 for more saturation and OUT down to about 50 to keep the level. Lower HIGH towards 40 for a darker, slower tape; raise LOW to thin the bass.
Turn MIX to 0 to hear the dry track, then back to 127. Re-selecting IRONOXIDE5 clears its internal state.
